:::{#exm-second-derivative-test}
#### Second derivative test for powers of $x$

The [function](functions.qmd#def-function) $f(x) = x^2$ has the [flat point](#def-flat-point) $c = 0$ and $f''(0) = 2 > 0$,
so $0$ is a local minimizer by @thm-second-derivative-test.

The functions $x^3$ and $x^4$ both have the flat point $0$ and second derivative $0$ there,
so the test does not decide.
Yet $x^4$ has a minimizer at $0$,
while $x^3$ has neither a minimizer nor a maximizer at $0$.

:::
